change: Interactive thread sculpture, editorial opening and paper notebook workspace
preserved: Memory-only session and encrypted file saving
Quick exit and visible session status

implementation.artwork: Original procedural geometry: three cords morph from a tangle into loose waves. Self-hosted Three.js loads separately from the functional interface. No external image or model requests.
implementation.interaction: A native range input works with keyboard, touch and pointer. The vector fallback shares the curve calculations and remains interactive when WebGL is unavailable.
implementation.motion: Low-power renderer, capped pixel density and 30fps idle drawing. Pauses on request, outside the viewport and in a hidden tab. Reduced-motion preference defaults to a static drawing with explicit opt-in playback.
implementation.workspace: Warm paper, green ink, coral and sage threads, large display type, ruled lists, margin lines and flat tabs. Clear starting choices remain separate from the optional illustration.
implementation.disclosure: The opening explains that the threads are an illustration and that Untangle cannot connect to or change accounts.

validation.localBrowserRun: 65 passed in the full run; three accessibility scenarios passed on rerun after contrast corrections.
checks: Starting controls fit within the viewport
Plan, file, history and consent regression tests
Manual WebGL, desktop and mobile-size browser review

limits: Browser checks do not replace physical-device testing or usability studies with the target audience. No new claim about live AI availability is made.
historicalArtwork: The earlier portrait assets and portrait-provenance.json are retained but are no longer used by the opening.
